one_liner: Vonage provides cloud communications APIs for SMS, MMS, voice, video, and verification services.

auth.notes: APIs support API Key and Secret, JWT tokens, and Basic authentication (Base64-encoded credentials). SIP Trunking also uses Digest authentication.

evidence.snippet: Vonage APIs support different authentication methods depending on which product you are using: API{filter} API Key and Secret (Header) JSON Web Token (JWT)
A number of newer Vonage APIs require authentication to be done using an API key and secret sent Base64 encoded in the Authorization header
The Vonage Client and Video SDKs use JWTs for authentication when a client connects to Vonage

access.notes: Developers can sign up for free demo/trial account and receive API key and secret. Trial accounts enable testing; production use requires adding credit. Some features like Email require additional approval.

evidence.snippet: sign up for an account . This will give you an API key and secret that you can use to access our APIs.
this feature is only available for demo or trial accounts until you add credit to your account
Request Email access. Submit a request in the Dashboard and include the API key you plan to use
